# Output changes in 0.87.0

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_behaviour_docs.py. Do not edit manually. -->

How the models 0.87.0 generates differ in behaviour from the models 0.86.0 generates. Both releases generated every test fixture and payload validation case of the repository with each output model type, with default options, with the released presets and with the documented CLI examples (tier `release`). Each generation (one input, output model type and option set) whose output differs was imported and compared by behaviour: public names, model kinds and bases, configuration, field types, constraints, aliases, defaults, required flags, enum members, constructor order, and the validation result of sample payloads.

| Output model type | same | no-behaviour | crash-fix | accepted | both-fail | opt-in |

| dataclasses.dataclass | 10302 | 28 | 318 | 7 | 667 | 20 |
| msgspec.Struct | 23581 | 44 | 1215 | 16 | 1708 | 22 |
| pydantic_v2.BaseModel | 23633 | 96 | 1135 | 138 | 1743 | 42 |

| Total | 76318 | 238 | 3396 | 201 | 5325 | 108 |

Generations per kind: documented CLI examples 244, default options 9530, payload validation cases 7196, released presets 68616.

- **same**: identical output
- **no-behaviour**: the output differs, the models behave the same (formatting, import order, redundant lines)
- **crash-fix**: the previous release failed to generate, import or validate; the new one works
- **accepted**: a behaviour change in default output that was decided and announced
- **both-fail**: both releases fail on the input
- **opt-in**: the generation uses an option or option value the previous release does not have

## Behaviour changes in default output

### propertyNames keys are typed as constrained str instead of a RootModel that could not be hashed

- Decision: #5017
- Why: propertyNames dict keys RootModel -> constrained str: 0.86.0 keys are unhashable (crash class)
- Affected: 67 generations of 7 inputs; pydantic_v2.BaseModel; option sets: `--preset practical-py310-20261017`, `--preset practical-py312-20260619`, `--preset practical-py312-20260826`, `--preset practical-py312-20260909`, `--preset practical-py312-20261015`, `--preset practical-py314-20261017`, `--preset standard-py310-20261017`, `--preset standard-py312-20260619`, `--preset standard-py312-20260826`, `--preset standard-py312-20260909`, `--preset standard-py312-20261015`, `--preset standard-py314-20261017`, `default`
- Changed aspects: type, config
- How to keep the old output: no option restores it

- Affected: 4 generations of 1 inputs; typing.TypedDict; option sets: `--preset practical-py310-20261017`, `--preset practical-py314-20261017`, `--preset standard-py310-20261017`, `--preset standard-py314-20261017`

### a submodule named like a builtin (list, dict, ...) is imported under an alias, so the module's list[...] annotations name the builtin again

- Decision: #5387
- Why: the shadowing submodule import made Holder unusable (TypeError on every decode / type-hint evaluation) in 0.86.0 (crash class)
- Affected: 2 generations of 1 inputs; pydantic_v2.BaseModel; option sets: `--preset practical-py314-20261017`, `--preset standard-py314-20261017`
- Changed aspects: import-path-removed
- How to keep the old output: `--all-exports-scope children`, `--all-exports-scope recursive`, `--enable-command-header`, `--enable-generated-header-marker`, `--enable-version-header`, `--no-use-standard-collections`, `--no-use-union-operator`, `--skip-root-model`, `--use-attribute-docstrings`, `--use-exact-imports`, `--use-generic-base-class`, `--use-generic-container-types`

`tests/data/jsonschema/module_import_named_like_builtin.json` (pydantic_v2.BaseModel, `--preset practical-py314-20261017`):

```diff
--- pkg/holder.py
+++ pkg/holder.py
@@ -5,5 +5,5 @@
 
 from . import app
-from .app import list
+from .app import list as list_1
 
 
@@ -13,4 +13,4 @@
     )
     tags: list[str] | None = None
-    pop: list.Pop | None = None
+    pop: list_1.Pop | None = None
     thing: app.Thing | None = None
```

### TypedDict extra_items names the referenced class under its final name

- Decision: #5022
- Why: 0.86.0's extra_items named the local Bar instead of the referenced external Bar (renamed Bar1); a wrong reference is fixed by default
- Affected: 2 generations of 1 inputs; typing.TypedDict; option sets: `--preset practical-py310-20261017`, `--preset practical-py314-20261017`
- Changed aspects: config
- How to keep the old output: no option restores it

`tests/data/openapi/typed_dict_extra_items_final_name/renamed.yaml` (typing.TypedDict, `--preset practical-py310-20261017`):

```diff
--- model.py
+++ model.py
@@ -15,4 +15,4 @@
 
 
-class Foo(TypedDict, extra_items='Bar'):
+class Foo(TypedDict, extra_items='Bar1'):
     name: NotRequired[str]
```
